title: Vaginal Cuff Closure in Robotic Hysterectomy
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the impact of implementing different types of suturing materials and techniques of vaginal cuff closure in robotic assisted laparoscopic hysterectomy on cost, operative time and post operative surgical outcomes.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Women scheduled for robotic assisted laparoscopic hysterectomy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who will not consent.
* Hysterectomy due to malignant conditions.
